name: Minecraft AFK Bot (MCC)
author: hydra@wyvernlabs.de
description: AFK bot based on Minecraft Console Client (MCC). It logs into a Minecraft Java server and stays there. MCC and the start script are set up automatically during the installation, the login comes from the startup variables.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -e
mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

case "$(uname -m)" in
  x86_64) ARCH="linux-x64" ;;
  aarch64) ARCH="linux-arm64" ;;
  *) echo "Unsupported architecture: $(uname -m)"; exit 1 ;;
esac

API="https://api.github.com/repos/MCCTeam/Minecraft-Console-Client/releases"
if [ -z "${MCC_RELEASE}" ] || [ "${MCC_RELEASE}" = "latest" ]; then
  API="${API}/latest"
else
  API="${API}/tags/${MCC_RELEASE}"
fi

URL=$(curl -fsSL "${API}" | jq -r --arg a "${ARCH}" '.assets[] | select(.name | endswith($a)) | .browser_download_url' | head -n 1)
if [ -z "${URL}" ]; then echo "No MCC download found for ${ARCH}"; exit 1; fi

echo "Downloading ${URL}"
curl -fsSL -o MinecraftClient "${URL}"
chmod +x MinecraftClient

cat > start.sh <<'STARTEOF'
#!/bin/bash
# Writes MinecraftClient.ini from the panel variables on every start and starts MCC.
cd /home/container || exit 1

if [ "${MC_AUTH}" = "offline" ]; then PASSWORD="-"; else PASSWORD=""; fi
VERSION="${MC_VERSION:-auto}"
DELAY="${RECONNECT_DELAY:-30}"
if [ "${ANTI_AFK}" = "1" ]; then AFK=true; else AFK=false; fi

cat > MinecraftClient.ini <<INI
[Main.General]
Account = { Login = "${MC_USERNAME}", Password = "${PASSWORD}" }
Server = { Host = "${MC_HOST}", Port = ${MC_PORT:-25565} }
AccountType = "microsoft"
Method = "mcc"

[Main.Advanced]
MinecraftVersion = "${VERSION}"

[ChatBot.AutoRelog]
Enabled = true
Delay = { min = ${DELAY}.0, max = ${DELAY}.0 }
Retries = -1
Ignore_Kick_Message = true

[ChatBot.AntiAFK]
Enabled = ${AFK}
Delay = { min = 60.0, max = 60.0 }
Use_Sneak = true
INI

echo "AFK bot started"
exec ./MinecraftClient MinecraftClient.ini BasicIO-NoColor
STARTEOF
chmod +x start.sh
echo "Installation complete"

variables.name: Server address
variables.description: Hostname or IP of the Minecraft server the bot should stay on.

variables.name: Username
variables.description: With Microsoft login the email of the account, in offline mode the player name you want.

variables.name: Login type
variables.description: microsoft for bought accounts, offline for servers in offline mode.

variables.name: Minecraft version
variables.description: auto to detect it, otherwise e.g. 26.2. Set it if the server does not answer the version query correctly.

variables.name: Reconnect delay
variables.description: Seconds the bot waits after the connection was lost.

variables.name: Anti-AFK
variables.description: 1 = the bot sneaks briefly once a minute so it is not kicked for being idle. 0 = off.

variables.name: MCC version
variables.description: latest for the newest version, otherwise a release tag like 20260929-519. Only used on (re)installation.
